name: Render UI
description: Render a safe, interactive declarative UI in the chat. Use for dashboards, forms, tables, charts, diagrams, and structured interactive results. For a full custom app with arbitrary HTML/JS, save an HTML artifact instead.

function.name: render_ui
function.description: Render or update an interactive UI tree in the chat. The tree is declarative JSON, not HTML or JavaScript. EVERY node needs a string type. Supported types: text, markdown, card, stack, grid, badge, divider, table, chart, mermaid, image, link, input, select, button. Root is usually type=card or type=stack with a children array. Example: {type:card,title:Sales,children:[{type:chart,data:[{label:Jan,value:10}]},{type:button,id:refresh,label:Refresh,action:refresh}]}. Prefer chart/table nodes over custom SVG/HTML. Use stable ui_id values. mode=replace sends a full tree; mode=patch sends JSON patch ops under /tree or /state. Every input/select/button needs id and action. Use save_artifact only for full custom HTML/JS apps.

mode.description: replace renders a full tree; patch applies up to 50 JSON operations to the existing ui_id.

tree.description: Root declarative UI node. Containers use children; table uses columns/rows; chart uses data [{label,value}]. Required for replace.

patch.description: Patch operations: {op:add|replace|remove,path:/tree/... or /state/...,value:...}. Required when patch mode has no tree.

state.description: Serializable UI state to retain across updates and reloads.
